description: Ask HenryKnows a question about F-1/J-1 student immigration, SEVIS, OPT, CPT or related rules and get a cited answer. Ask in the person's own terms; do not add identifiers. Answers take 10–40 seconds. Draws on HenryKnows' knowledge base and, when that is not enough, a live web search limited to official sources (government sites such as uscis.gov, ice.gov, state.gov, ecfr.gov and federalregister.gov, plus federal court records). Read-only: no copy of the question or answer is kept. Answers count toward a site-wide daily limit.

audience.description: professional (default): precise, regulation-cited. student: plain language for the student themselves.

question.description: The question, with the facts that matter (dates, degree level, category, employer type) and no names or ID numbers.
